Row.Text: "With law our land will rise and with lawlessness it will perish."
"Eagerly I accepted your sword, Njǫrðr of battle, and I will find no fault with it later. This is my wish – it is a praiseworthy pursuit."
"The ship was covered in gold above the water, with marvelous dragon heads and a double-sided sail of the most precious cloth."
"The battle-hardened enemy of the wolf gave to me the craft of poetry devoid of fault."

[TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval Units[/TIP] can [icon:Action_Pillage] Pillage and Coastal Raid tiles within 2 tiles. [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval Units[/TIP] can disperse [icon:INDEPENDENT_POWER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_INDEPENDENT_POWER_TOOLTIP]Independent Powers[/TIP] or [icon:Action_Pillage] Coastal Raid for 1 [icon:UNIT_MOVEMENT_ICON] Movement when in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTANT_LANDS_TOOLTIP]Distant Lands[/TIP]. Does not apply to Discoveries.

All [icon:CITY_BUILDING_LIST] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Buildings[/TIP] gain a +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Cultural and [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production Adjacency from Volcanoes and [icon:NOTIFICATION_DISCOVER_NATURAL_WONDER] Natural Wonders. (Natural Wonder Volcanoes do not count twice) +25% [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold towards purchasing [icon:ACTION_IMPROVE] Repairs.

Coastal Raiding and Pillaging with [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval Units[/TIP] grants [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture equal to 50% of [icon:Action_Pillage] Pillage Yields and [icon:Action_Heal] Healing.
+10 [icon:Action_Heal] Healing for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval Units[/TIP] outside friendly territory.

Coastal Raiding and Pillaging with [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval Units[/TIP] grants [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture equal to 25% of [icon:Action_Pillage] Pillage Yields and [icon:Action_Heal] Healing.
+20 [icon:Action_Heal] Healing for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval Units[/TIP] outside friendly territory.
Producing a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval Unit[/TIP] grants [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture equal to 50% of the Unit's [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production cost.

Producing a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval Unit[/TIP] grants [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture equal to 50% of the Unit's [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production cost. +1 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] Combat Strength for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval Units[/TIP] for each improved [icon:NOTIFICATION_DISCOVER_NATURAL_WONDER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NATURAL_WONDER_TOOLTIP]Natural Wonder[/TIP] in your empire.
[B]Iceland[/B] is able to endure throughout the Ages.
